cases.summary: Weird line when plotting staircase function
cases.description:
## Description of bug / unexpected behavior
I tried to plot a staircase function with a logarithmic x axis. The function is plotted correctly but there is a line in the graph that does not belong to the staircase function.


## Expected behavior
Do not print the line that does not belong to the function.


## How to reproduce the issue

Put the below code in `staircase.py` and run `manim -pql staircase.py BuggyStaircase`.

<details><summary>Code for reproducing the problem</summary>

```py
from manim import *

class BuggyStaircase(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-1, 5, 1],
            y_range=[0, 30, 5],
            x_axis_config={"scaling": LogBase()},
        )

        price = lambda x: 21 if x < 180 else 10 if x < 6000 else 6

        graph = axes.plot(price, x_range=[-1, 4.9, 0.001], use_smoothing=False)

        self.add(axes, graph)
```

</details>

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fixed :class:`.Axes` plotting bug with logarithmic x-axis
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fixed :class:`.Axes` plotting bug with logarithmic x-axis

The scaling function was not applied to the last x-value to be evaluated, resulting in a wrong point of the function plot and a weird line from the second-last to the last point when using a scaled x-axis. This PR fixes #2543.



## Overview: What does this pull request change?

Run `manim -pql scene.py Staircase` on `scene.py` containing this code:

```
from manim import *


class Staircase(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-1, 4],
            y_range=[0, 3],
            x_axis_config={"scaling": LogBase()},
        )

        price = lambda x: 2 if x < 10 else 1

        graph = axes.plot(price, x_range=[-1, 4], use_smoothing=False)

        self.add(axes, graph)

```

Before:

![before](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39318299/154083860-71fefe47-6d36-4b85-b1db-6f35b04f8735.png)

After:

![after](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39318299/154083901-07f317a3-8d70-4453-872b-af48ba34bcdd.png)
